intro_bn: এই গাইড CBLM 7-কে পাতার ক্রমে পড়ায়: আগে LO ও PC, তারপর Information sheet-এর চারটি অংশ, তারপর Job 1, Specification Sheet 1 আর Review of Competency।
প্রতিটি তথ্যের পাশে CBLM-এর পাতা নম্বর আছে; উদাহরণ, বাংলা ব্যাখ্যা আর memory tip শুধু শেখার সহায়ক।
মূল শিকল মনে রাখুন: Standard খুঁজুন → নিজেকে যাচাই করুন (gap) → Plan ও approval → Training → Competency প্রমাণ।
শেষে ৬টি Self Check, MCQ, matching, viva আর last-minute revision sheet দিয়ে নিজেকে যাচাই করুন।

After accessing the relevant competency standard document at
desired level, now it is required for the TVET teacher/trainer to
plan his self assessment in respect to the competency
standards.

This self assessment will be helpful for the
teacher/trainer to identify his/her skills and/or knowledge gaps.

cites.quote:
Self assessment is a way to assess someone's own skills, knowledge and
competencies in respect to some predefined standard to determine the
knowledge, skills and competencies gap to plan future training and up skilling
requirements.

answer.text: Self assessment assesses own skills, knowledge and competencies against a predefined standard. It finds the gap to plan training.

1.1 Job specification and volume of work is identified. 2.1 Indirect costs are identified and calculated. 2.2 Direct costs are identified and calculated. 3.1 Total cost of work is calculated.
TRAWEL4016A1 Perform Shielded Metal Arc Welding (SMAW) - Positions 5G and 6G

1. Follow OSH practises; 2. Identify weld requirements from drawing; 3. Select and prepare materials; 4. Set up Job; 5. Set up welding equipment; 6. Perform Shielded Metal Arc Welding- Position 5G, 6G; 7. Clean and store equipment.

1.1 Safe work practices observed and PPE worn. 2.1 Weld requirements identified from work place drawing. 3.1-3.5 Materials selected, marked, cut, edges prepared, assembled and aligned. 4.1 Job is set up using a clamp. 5.1 Welding equipment is set up and adjusted. 6.1-6.3 Weld performed, cleaned and checked for quality. 7.1 Equipment is cleaned and stored.
TRAWEL4017A1 Perform Shielded Metal Arc Welding (SMAW) - Position 6GR
Same seven elements, with Position 6G and job set up at position (6GR).
Same performance criteria as TRAWEL4016A1; 4.1 Job is set up using a clamp at required position (6GR).

rows: 1.1 Sources of competency standards documents are accessed for the relevant field.
2.1 Self assessment is planned and conducted to determine own technical competency in the relevant field based on relevant competency standards document.
2.2 Skills gaps are identified and documented with respect to the self assessment.
2.3 Knowledge gaps are identified and documented with respect to the self assessment.
3.1 Learning outcomes required to achieve competencies are identified.
3.2 Evidence requirements are identified to prove competency.
3.3 Learning/ training strategies including location, duration and cost of the training are identified in consultation with relevant personnel.
3.4 Relevant approval is gained to undertake training.
3.5 Own technical upskilling program is participated to achieve relevant competencies.
4.1 Evidence of competency to industry specialist is presented using agreed method.
4.2 Technical competency certification is completed and submitted to appropriate authority.

cites.quote: Evidence required for competency can be classified in two types
Direct Evidence
Indirect Evidence

keyPoints.text: Evidence is classified in two types: direct and indirect evidence.

cites.quote:
Direct Evidence: is evidence that can be observed or witnessed by the
Assessor

keyPoints.text: Direct evidence can be observed or witnessed by the assessor.

cites.quote:
Indirect Evidence: is evidence of the candidate's work that can be reviewed
or examined by the Assessor.

keyPoints.text: Indirect evidence is the candidate's work reviewed or examined by the assessor.

selfChecks.modelAnswer:
Evidence is classified in two types:
a. Direct evidence: observed or witnessed by the assessor, e.g. observation, oral questioning, demonstration.
b. Indirect evidence: the candidate's work reviewed by the assessor, e.g. finished products, written test, previous work, testimonials, evidence of training.

real.answer:
Evidence required for competency can be classified in two types
a. Direct Evidence
b. Indirect Evidence
